summary: An untracked-by-design Themes directory leaked into the implement branch as a symlink, bypassing .gitignore
detail: Sources/Hootty/Resources/Themes/ is gitignored as a directory because scripts/setup.sh populates it. A symlink with the same name (no trailing slash) bypassed the ignore rule and was staged in commit 8a23bc7. Removed in this review. A pre-commit guard or a stricter gitignore entry (e.g., also ignoring the symlink form) would prevent this class of accidental commit.

summary: ContentView.onChange does two O(n) scans of appModel.workspaces per workspace switch
detail: Both branches call appModel.workspaces.first(where:). The pattern matches existing code (e.g. handleRemoveWorkspace) so left as-is, but an AppModel.workspace(id: UUID) helper would dedupe several call sites across ContentView/HoottyApp.

summary: @MainActor isolation of GhosttyApp is implicit at SwiftUI onChange call sites
detail: Calls into the @MainActor GhosttyApp from SwiftUI .onChange closures rely on inherited isolation. This works today but is not documented anywhere as a convention; a context note in context/ghostty.md or context/swift-patterns.md would help future contributors.
